2026-12-23.title: 23 December · Advent Weekday (O Emmanuel)
readings: I will send you the prophet Elijah before the day of the Lord comes
Lift up your heads and see; your redemption is near at hand
The birth of John the Baptist
2026-12-23.alt: O Antiphon: O Emmanuel. Optional memorial: St John of Kanty, priest.
2026-12-23.verse: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And all of them were amazed. Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, praising God.
theo: The last O Antiphon: “O Emmanuel, our King and Lawgiver, the hope of the nations and their Saviour: come and save us, O Lord our God.” Malachi, the last of the prophets, announces a messenger who will prepare the way, and the Lord who will suddenly come to his temple, like a refiner's fire. He will send Elijah “to turn the hearts of parents to their children”.

In the Gospel the messenger is born. Neighbours rejoice with Elizabeth because the Lord has shown great mercy to her. At the circumcision they want to call the child Zechariah, after his father, but Elizabeth says, “No; he is to be called John.” Zechariah, mute for nine months, writes, “His name is John”, and his tongue is freed to praise God. John means “The Lord has shown favour”. The name is not the family's choice but God's gift: this child belongs to God's plan. “What then will this child become?” For “the hand of the Lord was with him.”
outline: Ask: what does your name mean, and who chose it?
God's favour breaks the silence into praise.
“The hand of the Lord was with him.”
live: Find out your baptismal saint and ask his or her intercession.
Say a word of praise to God, and a kind word to someone, each hour today.
2026-12-23.prayer: O Emmanuel, our King and Lawgiver, hope and Saviour of the nations, come and save us, O Lord our God. As you freed Zechariah's tongue, open my lips to praise you, and let your hand be with me. Amen.
altar: At Mass the Lord whom we seek comes suddenly to his temple, the altar, and to the temple of our hearts.

quick: The Lord comes like a refiner's fire.
2026-12-23.action: Ask your baptismal saint to pray for you today.
2026-12-23.question: Is the hand of the Lord with me, and do I let it guide me?

family.explain: Zechariah obeyed God and named his baby John, and then he could speak again and praise God.
family.intention: We pray for peace between parents and children.
family.ask: Ask: “Is there someone we need to make peace with before Christmas?”

pm.open: O Emmanuel, our King and Lawgiver, hope of the nations, come and save us, O Lord our God. As we gather on the threshold of Christmas, prepare our hearts. Amen.
share: Zechariah wrote: his name is John (Luke 1:63). In what have I delayed obeying God?
Malachi speaks of turning the hearts of parents and children (Malachi 3:24). What relationship in my family needs healing?
The people asked: what will this child become? (Luke 1:66). What do I hope for the children in my life?
pm.resp: O Emmanuel, come and save us.
interc: For the Church, that she may welcome Emmanuel with joy.
For families divided, that hearts may be turned to one another.
For children, that the hand of the Lord may be upon them.
For all who travel home for Christmas, that they may arrive safely.
For our group, that we may be ready to receive the Lord.
pm.close: Lord God, your Son is coming soon. Turn our hearts to you and to one another, loosen our tongues for praise, and make us ready to welcome Emmanuel. Amen.

illus: A grandfather in Pala, who had not spoken to his son for years after a quarrel, was asked by his little grandson on 23 December: “Why don't you talk to Papa?” That night he phoned. They spent Christmas together for the first time in seven years.

homily: Dear friends, today's O Antiphon, the last, prays: O Emmanuel, our King and Lawgiver, the hope of the nations and their Saviour: come and save us, O Lord our God. Read backwards, the first letters of the antiphons in Latin spell ERO CRAS: tomorrow I will be there (T).

Malachi announces: see, I am sending my messenger to prepare the way before me, and the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple. Then he promises to send the prophet Elijah, who will turn the hearts of parents to their children and the hearts of children to their parents (Malachi 3:1, 23–24).

In the Gospel Elizabeth gives birth to her son. Neighbours and relatives want to name him Zechariah after his father. But Elizabeth says: no; he is to be called John. They ask Zechariah, and he writes on a tablet: his name is John. Immediately his mouth is opened and he begins to speak, praising God (Luke 1:57–64).

John means God is gracious. The name was not chosen by family custom but by God. Zechariah's obedience, writing the name God gave, loosened his tongue. When we obey God, even after doubting, our lips are opened for praise.
The people asked: what then will this child become? For the hand of the Lord was with him (Luke 1:66). Every child is a mystery and a promise. Every child is born with God's hand upon them.

On the eve of Christmas Eve, let us obey God in whatever he has asked and we have delayed. Let us turn our hearts to our families, as Malachi says. And let us pray with longing: O Emmanuel, come. Tomorrow I will be there. Amen.
kids: Children, Zechariah could not speak until he obeyed God; then he praised God. When we obey God, our hearts are happy!

intro: The messenger is born; the Lord comes as refiner's fire; silence breaks into praise.

sub: Jesus says John is that messenger.
He prepares the way of the Lord.
q: See, I am sending my messenger to prepare the way before me, and the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple. The messenger of the covenant in whom you delight—indeed, he is coming, says the LORD of hosts.
This is the one about whom it is written, ‘See, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’
points.apply: Prepare one practical thing for Christmas with prayer.

sub: Christ baptises with Spirit and fire.
q: But who can endure the day of his coming, and who can stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner's fire and like fullers' soap; he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the descendants of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, until they present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
I baptize you with water for repentance, but one who is more powerful than I is coming after me; I am not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
points.apply: Make your Christmas Confession today or tomorrow.

q: Listen to me, O coastlands, pay attention, you peoples from far away! The LORD called me before I was born, while I was in my mother's womb he named me.
He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And all of them were amazed. Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, praising God.
points.apply: Praise God aloud for one mercy today.

2026-12-23.resolve: Be reconciled with someone before Christmas Eve.
